patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with a consistent maximum width for text and interactive elements, centered on a dark background.
Key words within large section headings are highlighted with an accent color, drawing attention to specific features or concepts.
A deep, near-black background is used consistently across the entire site, providing a high-contrast canvas for light text and vibrant accent colors.
As the user scrolls, specific keywords within prominent section headings dynamically change and re-highlight, creating an interactive narrative that reveals different aspects of the product.
Code examples are presented in stylized, interactive blocks with syntax highlighting and 'Run' buttons, integrated directly into feature descriptions.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-driven content storytelling system where key phrases within prominent headings dynamically update and re-emphasize different words as the user scrolls, guiding the narrative and highlighting various features. This effect is likely achieved using a JavaScript library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.
Utilize a full-width hero section featuring an autoplaying, muted video embedded within a stylized frame, providing dynamic visual context for the product.
Design interactive code snippets within visually distinct blocks, complete with syntax highlighting and 'Run' buttons, to enhance engagement for a technical audience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and code blocks, giving a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between sections, with comfortable padding within content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the scroll-triggered text animation within section headings, where highlighted keywords dynamically change as the user scrolls. This creates an engaging, interactive narrative that feels highly tailored for a technical audience, making the site feel more like an interactive presentation than a static page.
